nodes.name: Studio - Validate Request
nodes.notes: Study Studio mind map. Re-checks the request (1-10 sources, <=5 images, description <=1000, language in the list, server token estimate <= cfg:studio_max_tokens, default 400000, hard maximum 900000) and builds the Gemini request. Rejections return only a fixed error code, never request text.

nodes.name: Studio - Call Gemini
nodes.notes: gemini-2.5-flash (flash-lite only on attempt 3), JSON mode with the mind map schema. Node timeout comes from the item (240000 ms, shorter when the request budget is running out). Never errors: failures are handled by Studio - Retry Check.

nodes.name: Studio - Validate
nodes.notes: Parses, validates and repairs the mind map (single root, orphans, cycles, depth, caps, citations checked against the request sources). Pure function: no network, no globals.

nodes.name: Job Start Endpoint
nodes.notes: Starts a background job (op create). JWT required. Answers {"ok":true,"accepted":true} as soon as the request is queued; the run continues and stores its result in Upstash.

nodes.name: Job Endpoint
nodes.notes: Background jobs: hello / status / result / ack / cancel. JWT required. Ids and keys are read from the POST body only.

nodes.name: Job - Pick Envelope
nodes.notes: Keeps only v, op, job, jobs of the request. The (possibly large) request body never enters the job gateway Code nodes.

nodes.name: Job - Read Request
nodes.notes: All job settings live here (JOBS_ENABLED, JOB_MODES, caps, deadlines, TTLs). Validates the envelope; never throws.

nodes.name: Job - Hash Key
nodes.notes: SHA-256 (hex) of the job key. Only the hash is ever stored in Upstash.

nodes.name: Job - Plan
nodes.notes: Builds the Redis call for the operation and drops the plain key.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ ["EVAL", "local c=redis.call('HMGET',KEYS[1],'kh','st','a','d') local att,now=tonumber(ARGV[3]),tonumber(ARGV[4])
if c[1] then
  if c[1]~=ARGV[1] then return {'keymismatch'} end
  local a=tonumber(c[3]) local lost=c[2]=='running' and now>tonumber(c[4])+tonumber(ARGV[9])
  if not ((c[2]=='rejected' and att==a) or ((c[2]=='failed' or lost) and att==a+1)) then return {'duplicate',c[2]} end
  if lost then redis.call('ZREM',KEYS[5],ARGV[11]..':'..c[3]) end
end
local o=tonumber(redis.call('GET',KEYS[4]) or '') local cap=tonumber(ARGV[8]) if o then cap=math.max(0,math.min(o,12)) end
local function rej(code) redis.call('HSET',KEYS[1],'kh',ARGV[1],'m',ARGV[2],'st','rejected','a',att,'c',now,'e',code) redis.call('EXPIRE',KEYS[1],ARGV[13]) end
if cap==0 then rej('{"code":"STH-JOB-503"}') return {'off'} end
local total,mine=0,0
for i=5,#KEYS do redis.call('ZREMRANGEBYSCORE',KEYS[i],'-inf',now) local n=redis.call('ZCARD',KEYS[i]) total=total+n if i==5 then mine=n end end
if total>=cap or mine>=tonumber(ARGV[7]) then rej('{"code":"STH-JOB-429"}') redis.call('HINCRBY',KEYS[3],'busy',1) redis.call('EXPIRE',KEYS[3],2592000) return {'busy'} end
if c[1] then redis.call('HDEL',KEYS[1],'f','fa','rb') end
redis.call('HSET',KEYS[1],'kh',ARGV[1],'m',ARGV[2],'st','running','a',att,'s',now,'d',ARGV[5],'x',ARGV[10],'e','')
redis.call('HSETNX',KEYS[1],'c',now) redis.call('EXPIRE',KEYS[1],ARGV[6])
redis.call('ZADD',KEYS[5],tonumber(ARGV[5])+tonumber(ARGV[9]),ARGV[11]..':'..att) redis.call('EXPIRE',KEYS[5],86400)
redis.call('SET',KEYS[2],ARGV[11]..'|'..att..'|'..ARGV[2],'EX',ARGV[12])
redis.call('HINCRBY',KEYS[3],'admitted',1) redis.call('EXPIRE',KEYS[3],2592000)
return {'admitted'}", String($json.keys.length), ...$json.keys, ...$json.argv] }}

nodes.name: Job - Admit
nodes.notes: ADMIT (atomic): idempotent create, running caps per mode and in total (cfg:jobs_max_running overrides the total, 0 = off), records sth:job:<id>, the execution map sth:jobx:<execution id> and the running-set sth:jobs:run:<mode>. Fail-closed: if Upstash does not answer, the run ends here.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ ["EVAL", "local c=redis.call('HMGET',KEYS[1],'kh','st')
if c[1] and not (c[1]==ARGV[1] and c[2]=='rejected') then return 'duplicate' end
redis.call('HSET',KEYS[1],'kh',ARGV[1],'m',ARGV[2],'st','rejected','a',ARGV[3],'c',ARGV[4],'e',ARGV[5])
redis.call('EXPIRE',KEYS[1],ARGV[6]) return 'rejected'", String($json.keys.length), ...$json.keys, ...$json.argv] }}

nodes.name: Job - Result Read

nodes.name: Job - Ack
nodes.notes: ACK: deletes the record and the result of finished jobs, when the key hash matches.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ $json.jobs.map((j) => ["EVAL", "local c=redis.call('HMGET',KEYS[1],'kh','st')
if not c[1] or c[1]~=ARGV[1] then return 'unknown' end
if c[2]=='running' or c[2]=='rejected' then
  redis.call('HSET',KEYS[1],'st','cancelled','f',ARGV[2]) redis.call('EXPIRE',KEYS[1],ARGV[3]) redis.call('DEL',KEYS[2]) return 'cancelled'
end
return c[2]", "2", j.job, j.jobr, j.kh, String($json.now), String($json.rejectTtlS)]) }}

nodes.name: Job - Cancel
nodes.notes: CANCEL: marks a running or rejected job cancelled (result discarded) when the key hash matches. The run slot is not freed while the execution still runs.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ ["EVAL", "redis.call('ZREM',KEYS[3],ARGV[7])
local c=redis.call('HMGET',KEYS[1],'st','a')
if c[1]~='running' then return c[1] or 'gone' end
if ARGV[2]~='succeeded' and c[2]~=ARGV[1] then return 'stale' end
if ARGV[2]=='succeeded' then redis.call('SET',KEYS[2],ARGV[4],'EX',ARGV[6]) end
redis.call('HSET',KEYS[1],'st',ARGV[2],'e',ARGV[3],'f',ARGV[5],'fa',ARGV[1],'rb',string.len(ARGV[4]))
redis.call('EXPIRE',KEYS[1],ARGV[6]) redis.call('HINCRBY',KEYS[4],ARGV[2],1) redis.call('EXPIRE',KEYS[4],2592000) return 'stored'", "4", ...$json.keys, ...$json.argv] }}

nodes.name: Job - Store Outcome
nodes.notes: STORE (atomic): a success from any attempt is accepted while the job is running; a failure only from the current attempt; cancelled or finished jobs discard. Retried 3 times (repeating it is harmless).

nodes.name: Job - Error Lookup
nodes.notes: Maps the failed execution id to the job (sth:jobx:<execution id> = id|attempt|mode).

nodes.name: Job - Error Outcome
nodes.notes: A job execution threw: stores failed with a code taken from the error message (the message itself is never stored).
